Learn

The information you have been looking for.

Open to everyone, whether you ever buy anything from us or not. This is the part of Saede that exists for the mission rather than the margin.

Our founder spent more than four years piecing this together herself, late at night, from research papers, because nobody would explain it to her. Putting it behind a paywall would make us exactly the thing we are annoyed about.

So the education is free. That includes the parts where the right answer is not a supplement — including minoxidil, which is a medicine, and which we write about because you deserve to understand your options rather than only the one we sell.

If what you actually need is a doctor, we would rather you found that out here.

What to ask your doctor

Saede is a food supplement. It is not a substitute for a varied, balanced diet or a healthy lifestyle, and it is not a substitute for medical care. If you are losing your hair, please also see a doctor and get your blood tested. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding or taking medication, speak to a healthcare professional before starting.
